title: Why didn't Shrek stop the Fyre Festival disaster in 2017?
post: The Fyre Festival promised luxury villas... and served a cheese sandwich. So why didn't Shrek stop it? Would you pay $12,000 for this? 👇 #shrek #fyrefestival #cheesesandwich #dreamworks #didyouknow #memes
